title: Limit Theory for U-Statistics under Clustered and Weakly Dependent Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.18443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops asymptotic theory and feasible inference for unbounded-kernel order-k U-statistics under clustered sampling and weakly dependent time-series sampling. The analysis first builds the complete order-2 pipeline, moving from clustered data to exact m-dependence and then to near-epoch dependence. The same logic is subsequently extended to general order k greater than or equal to 2. Under clustered sampling, the theory allows arbitrary within-cluster dependence and growing, unbalanced cluster sizes. Under weak dependence, an i.i.d.-based approximating sequence carries the exact-m theory to near-epoch-dependent processes. The common combinatorial device is a vertical rearrangement, which isolates sampling-generic tuples, where the first-order Hoeffding projection is analysed, from collision terms and higher-order degenerate remainders, which are controlled explicitly. translated_title: 聚类与弱相依数据下U统计量的极限理论
translated_abstract: 本文针对聚类抽样和弱相依时间序列抽样下的无界核k阶U统计量，建立了渐近理论和可行推断方法。分析首先构建完整的二阶管道，从聚类数据过渡到精确m相依，再过渡到近邻相依。随后，相同的逻辑扩展到一般阶数k≥2。在聚类抽样下，该理论允许簇内任意相依性和增长的不平衡簇大小。在弱相依下，基于独立同分布的逼近序列将精确m理论推广到近邻相依过程。共同的组合工具是垂直重排，它将采样通用元组（其中分析一阶Hoeffding投影）与碰撞项和高阶退化余项（这些被显式控制）分离。聚类稳健和HAC估计量用于协方差。
tldr: 本文提出了聚类和弱相依数据下无界核U统计量的统一极限理论，通过垂直重排技术处理采样通用项与退化余项，并支持可行推断。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified limit theory for unbounded-kernel U-statistics under clustered and weakly dependent data, using vertical rearrangement to handle sampling-generic terms and degenerate remainders, enabling feasible inference.
